Build a shift-handover screen: alarm density over the last 12 hours, current buffer levels, and a station health comparison so the next crew knows what they're walking into.
Build a bottleneck dashboard: which station is actually setting the line's throughput right now, a material flow view, and a bar chart comparing every station's rate.

ai.tools.description: Use this tool to get a list of available widgets
ai.tools.title: getAvailableWidgets

ai.tools.code:
# The dashboard component is on the page and this chat is in a dock, so the
	# layout is handed over as a Perspective message rather than a property write.
	#
	# It has to be session scope with an explicit sessionId. An ai.tools script
	# runs on a gateway thread with no session attached to it, so a bare
	# page-scoped send fails with "No perspective session attached to this
	# thread" -- which surfaces as the tool returning Failed and the agent
	# apologising, not as anything in the gateway log.
	system.perspective.sendMessage(
		messageType='exchange.dashboard.setWidgets',
		payload={'widgets': config},
		scope='session',
		sessionId=self.session.props.id)
	return 'Wrote %d widget(s) to the dashboard.' % len(config)
ai.tools.description: Use this tool to write the dashboard's widget layout once you have decided what to display. Never modify availableWidgets -- only write the widgets list itself.

parameters.description: The full list of widgets to display on the dashboard. Each entry must follow the shape of an availableWidgets entry, plus a position object.
parameters.name: config

ai.tools.title: writeDashboardConfiguration
